description: Rank every filer in a loaded period by their reported value for ONE XBRL tag — the inverse of a per-company lookup, e.g. "who reported the highest AccountsPayableCurrent this quarter". Give the exact tag name and (usually) a period-end date (ddate, YYYYMMDD). Set dimensioned_only=true to see only segment/geography-level breakdowns rather than consolidated totals.

ddate.description: Period-end date, YYYYMMDD (e.g. "20260630"). Omit to rank across all loaded periods for this tag.

dimensioned_only.description: true to return only segment/geography-dimensioned rows, skipping consolidated totals.

version.description: Optional taxonomy version, e.g. "us-gaap/2026". Omit to match any version.

name: tag_cross_company_screen
title: Tag Cross Company Screen
